name: remarkable-publish
description: Render a document or drawing and push it to a reMarkable tablet, via a self-hosted protomarkable MCP server.

protomarkable_server_url.title: ProtoMarkable MCP server URL
protomarkable_server_url.description: HTTP URL of the deployed protomarkable MCP server, used by the remarkable-publish skill.

protomarkable_auth_token.title: ProtoMarkable bearer token
protomarkable_auth_token.description: The MCP_AUTH_TOKEN configured on that server. Get it from /opt/protomarkable/.env on the deploy VM.
